extracted.intended_audience: Eligible Damon Runyon Fellows (postdoctoral/early-career cancer researchers) applying for the Dale F. Frey Award
extracted.subtask_short: Damon Runyon Dale F. Frey Award application
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation and submission of an application for the Damon Runyon Dale F. Frey Award, including required documents (2-page research summary, NIH biosketch, bibliography, lists of presentations/support, and reference letters) and compliance with formatting and deadline rules. Targeted to Damon Runyon Fellows who meet the specified cohort eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Damon Runyon Fellows selected in November 2022 and May 2023 (DRG-2483-23 to DRG-2512-23), and Damon Runyon Quantitative Biology Fellows selected in February 2024 (DRQ-19-24 to DRQ-22-24) are eligible to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only applicants from the specified cohorts are eligible. (Implicit: verify selection cohort before preparing application.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: All applications must be submitted through Proposal Central by 4:00 PM Eastern Time on July 15, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications will not be accepted outside Proposal Central or after the stated deadline/time. Ensure all components (including reference letters) are uploaded by this deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-page combined summary (research progress, vision, and career goals)
rubrics_metrics.description: A brief a) summary of research progress and accomplishments under the Damon Runyon Fellowship, b) description of research vision and its potential impact on cancer, and c) description and projected timeline (next 5-10 years) of career goals. Parts a, b, and c are not to exceed two pages in total.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formatting: single-spaced, 12-point type with at least 0.5-inch margins. Figures and references are to be included in the 2-page limit. Be concise; the three parts together must fit within the two-page constraint.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Biosketch (non-fellowship) with required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Up-to-date NIH Biosketch (non-fellowship) including: A. Personal Statement; B. Positions and Honors (Research and Professional Positions; Other Experience and Professional Memberships; Honors/Fellowships/Awards); C. Contributions to Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an NIH-style biosketch that reflects current (non-fellowship) status and includes the enumerated subsections. Use standard NIH biosketch formatting and content conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full bibliography with hyperlinks
rubrics_metrics.description: Full Bibliography with Hyperlinks. Include hyperlinks to preprints on bioRxiv. If you include a manuscript that is in preparation, indicate the anticipated timeframe until submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete citations with working hyperlinks. For works-in-preparation, explicitly state expected submission timing to give reviewers context about pipeline and productivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of conferences, seminars, invited talks and posters during the Damon Runyon Fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: A list of Conferences and Seminars Attended, Invited Talks Given and Posters Presented during your Damon Runyon Fellowship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document scholarly visibility and dissemination during the Fellowship period; include dates/venues as appropriate to demonstrate engagement and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of ongoing research support (current and pending funding)
rubrics_metrics.description: A list of Ongoing Research Support with current and pending funding sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose all active and pending support to allow assessment of resources and potential overlap. Include sponsor, project title, period, and amount as relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letters: number, source, and content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Two reference letters must be submitted to Proposal Central on or before the application deadline date. Referees are asked to rank the applicant's research and leadership potential in comparison with others at a comparable career stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters should be from: (1) current Damon Runyon Fellowship Sponsor (if there are two Sponsors, submit only one letter in conjunction), and (2) a qualified individual, external to the institution where the applicant is completing their postdoctoral research, who can evaluate the applicant’s impact in the field of cancer research and assess their potential for successful independent cancer research. The second referee may not be a collaborator, coauthor, or current/former mentor of the applicant. Note: Applicants will NOT be able to submit their application unless all reference letters are uploaded to the portal by the deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finalist interviews
rubrics_metrics.description: A small number of finalists will be interviewed by members of the Fellowship Award Committee in Fall 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection as a finalist includes an interview step; be prepared to discuss research progress, vision, and leadership potential with committee members. Interview scheduling and logistics will be communicated to selected finalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award start date rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The award can begin immediately following the term of the original Fellowship. For those whose Fellowships have already ended, the award can begin on January 1, 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan start dates and any institutional approvals accordingly; award period cannot start earlier than the end of the original Fellowship unless timing matches the stated rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and notification practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Please notify the Foundation immediately of any changes to your contact information provided in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep contact details current to ensure receipt of finalist/award communications; failure to update contact info may affect notifications.
